reason: Machine lens: every opcode is 65SC12 (BRA, ASL A, ADC/SBC zp/#, ORA/LDA (zp),Y, ORA #); no BBR/RMB/WAI/STP. sky_row ends LDA sky_skip/RTS so A=skip and Z from it; geometry (sky_hazel.6502) makes whole rows rt=7 with sky_ry a multiple of 8 (also in the &7FFF split: 256-rl-8 and ytop-rc, rl a multiple of 8), so Y=8k+7 and the 8x unroll reads exactly the original bytes. Part setup: skip 1..7, ASL ASL leaves C clear (<=28), ADC gives 5*skip<=35 C clear, SBC #4 with C clear = 5*(skip-1) 0..30 with C set; slots are 5 bytes (B1 zp, D0 rel, 88), so offset enters leaving 8-skip = sky_n slots; the BRA offset byte is ckp_br+1 in bank 4 sideways RAM (writable, paged while it runs, outside ANDY), written before every use in the row and still valid on the BPL ckp_br loop-back. C stays set through LDA/BNE/DEY/TYA, and SBC sky_skip's borrow only on a negative result that exits, so dropping SEC is exact. X untouched by sky_row and the new paths; sky_q is only read by sky_draw/sky_zero after their own STX. Layout: new code puts ckp_br at ~&A355, its targets &A357-&A375, all in page &A3: the BRA never crosses a page; all branches well within range (BNE row ~-92). Bytes recounted: old 48, new 97 (+49, i.e. claim -49 correct; render data end &B37D -> &B3AE, under REN_BASE &B400). Knock-on page crossings of the moved tables: sprite_column_count (none either way), ck_index,Y now crosses for Y>=&1D (was >=&4E: entries &27,&37,&47 gain +1), straight_sprite_hi stops crossing (-1 on every straight draw, X &35-&4A), straight_sprite_lo starts crossing for X>=&37 (+1): roughly a wash, and the claim's cycles are a measured pcprof difference on a build containing this layout, so they include these. Routine's own saving recounted: whole row 10 + 21*(k+1) cycles (STX/LDX 6, LDA #0 2, 21 per 8 bytes, TAX/BNE/BRA vs ORA#/BEQ 2); part row sum over cells (5n+1) - 7 (13 setup vs 6 STX/LDX); for typical 3-4 character-row, 6-10 column clean rectangles this is a few hundred cycles, consistent with the measured 478.
